sequence.concept: Study biological mechanisms from cells and genes to organismal physiology, evolution, biodiversity and ecosystems, with laboratory, quantitative and environmental chemical methods. This broad programme responds to the confirmed common Biology core; specialisation and thesis equivalence are excluded.
sequence.judgment: A sustained broad response supported by actual cells/genetics, human physiology, microbes, evolution, ecosystem/biodiversity, biological lab and specific quantitative/chemical mechanisms. Strengthen chemistry rather than treating an unrelated climate communication course or health allocation as the strongest possible response.

sequence.concept: Concentrate on molecular and cellular mechanisms, physiology, genetics, infection and immunity, with neural and biological data methods. This is a distinct health-focused response to the confirmed common Biology core, without claiming the external specialisation or thesis pathway.
sequence.judgment: Seven courses/52.5EC differ from the stronger broad programme: environmental and ecosystem priorities give way to molecular/neural mechanisms and image, prediction and neural-network methods. Actual subject and method consequences generate the difference, rather than four arbitrary substitutions.

sequence.concept: Concentrates on biodiversity, ecology, evolution, conservation, organisms, climate, soils, farming, environmental observation and field-based research across changing ecosystems.
sequence.judgment: The ecological question is evidenced and coherent, but the retained concrete plan is only3courses/22.5EC different from the stronger closest programme. Reject as not-substantively-distinct; no invented replacement palette to attain a numerical floor.

stopping: Stop at two. Additional ecological candidate fails pairwise30EC/four-course floor against the academically stronger closest programme. Earlier three conditional research plans are retained as evidence, not adopted automatically.
coreGaps: Chemistry/physics breadth, plant function/reproduction/development, full comparative vertebrate and invertebrate/algal/fungal practical formation, biology-specific philosophy/ethics and some quantitative methods remain gaps. These are included-core differences; they are not removed from the assessed105EC merely to make approval possible.
counterargument: The confirmed core is not generic orientation. It contains sustained multiscale biological subjects and experimental/quantitative inquiry. Actual UCR biology spans cell mechanisms, genetics, physiology, microbes, evolution, biodiversity and ecological process with laboratory work, unlike a programme of general environmental context alone. This supports a broader limited response despite honest missing specialist depth. RO3/chair resolutions could alter full-degree comparability and remain excluded in full.
